# NRPN data

```{r}
means2010 <- read.csv("./2010NRPN/Yield-Table 1.csv",header=TRUE)
names(means2010)[-(1:2)] <-  paste(names(means2010)[-(1:2)],'2010')
means2011 <- read.csv("./2011NRPN/Yield-Table 1.csv",header=TRUE)
names(means2011)[-(1:2)] <-  paste(names(means2011)[-(1:2)],'2011')
means2012 <- read.csv("./2012NRPN/Yields-Table 1.csv",header=TRUE)
names(means2012)[-(1:2)] <-  paste(names(means2012)[-(1:2)],'2012')
means2013 <- read.csv("./2013NRPN/Yield-Table 1.csv",header=TRUE)
names(means2013)[-(1:2)] <-  paste(names(means2013)[-(1:2)],'2013')
means2014 <- read.csv("./2014NRPN/Yield-Table 1.csv",header=TRUE)
names(means2014)[-(1:2)] <-  paste(names(means2014)[-(1:2)],'2014')
```

```{r}
means <- merge(means2010[,-1],means2011[,-1],by='Line')
unique(means$Line)
dim(means)
means <- merge(means,means2012[,-1],by='Line')
unique(means$Line)
dim(means)
means <- merge(means,means2013[,-1],by='Line')
unique(means$Line)
dim(means)
means <- merge(means,means2014[,-1],by='Line')
unique(means$Line)
dim(means)
```

```{r}
entries <- means[,1]
means <- t(means[,-1])
colnames(means) <- entries
```

```{r}
trt.means <- colMeans(means,na.rm=TRUE)

best <- which(rank(trt.means)==max(rank(trt.means)))
second <- which(rank(trt.means)==max(rank(trt.means))-1)
worst <- which(rank(trt.means)==min(rank(trt.means)))
```


## Best vs Second best


```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=5}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
HtHWaterfall(means,best,second, error='nonpar',basis='Difference')
HtHWaterfall(means,best,second, error='normal',basis='Difference')
```


## Best vs Worst
```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=5}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
HtHWaterfall(means,best,worst, error='nonpar',basis='Difference')
HtHWaterfall(means,best,worst, error='normal',basis='Difference')
```

## Most Similar Pair

```{r,fig.width=12,fig.height=5}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
HtHWaterfall(means,1,4, error='nonpar',basis='Difference')
HtHWaterfall(means,1,4, error='normal',basis='Difference')
```
